name: SearchBox
description: A search field that sends the visitor to the site's search page (`/search?q=…`): a plain GET form with a labelled role=search landmark, no JavaScript. For a header slot or inline in a page.

size.description: Field and button height (36 and 44 px).

width.description: A compact field (up to 20 rem) or the whole column.

button.description: The button reads its label, or shows a magnifier named by the same label.

labelStyle.description: The field's label for assistive technology only, or printed above the field.

action.description: The search page the form sends to; it reads `q`.

label.description: The landmark's and field's accessible name (ui-strings search.label).

placeholder.description: Hint text in the field (ui-strings search.placeholder).

id.description: Prefix of the field's id; set it when two search boxes share a page.

a11y: A <form role="search"> with a real <label> for the type=search field (sr-only unless shown); the button has a text or aria-label name; focus rings on both.
